objective: concentrate each enabled product repository on one persistent product-completion target until all objective exit criteria are verified

waveContract.priority: complete the active macrocycle or reduce its verified critical path

hourlyClosureSweep.position: final scheduled wave of each hour
hourlyClosureSweep.purpose: convert every closable active macrocycle into a certified completion instead of spending the final wave on incidental refinement
forEveryEnabledProject: reconcile live GitHub state and exact integrated SHA
evaluate every exit criterion and completion gate
if a missing criterion is safely satisfiable in the sweep, execute only the minimum work required to satisfy it
verify independent review, Product CI exact-SHA evidence, Robot QA, integration state and required post-merge replay
activate the next declared macrocycle immediately after successful closure
hourlyClosureSweep.closureInvariant: If the active macrocycle is closable from available or safely obtainable evidence, it MUST NOT remain ACTIVE at the end of the closure sweep.
hourlyClosureSweep.nextMacrocycleRule: Closing a macrocycle MUST activate the next declared macrocycle in the same sweep. Activation is required; substantive implementation of the newly activated macrocycle waits for the next normal productive wave unless needed to preserve repository coherence.
forbiddenDuringSweep: polish or hardening not required by a named completion gate
repeating already-green checks without new evidence need
control-plane churn that does not close or unblock the active macrocycle
hourlyClosureSweep.blockedRule: If closure is prevented only by a true non-bypassable human or infrastructure gate, persist the exact missing criterion and blocker; continue closure attempts on the other enabled projects.
hourlyClosureSweep.successMetric: certified macrocycles closed and next macrocycles activated, not commits, pull requests, waves, test count or administrative activity

statePrecedence: live integration-lane head and commit ancestry
exact-SHA Product CI and Robot QA

staleStateProtection.rule: A completed or merged work item may never be reconstructed as active solely from an older comment, receipt or project-state snapshot.

queueReadiness.readyZeroMeaning: discover and specify structural work inside the same active macrocycle; do not change macrocycle

robotPolicy.robotFailure: keep macrocycle active, fix on the canonical branch, review, retest and replay

accepted: directly satisfies an exit criterion of the active macrocycle
removes a blocker of the active macrocycle
tests, reviews or secures the active macrocycle
restores build, CI, persistence or recovery required by the active macrocycle
rejected: another preview, dashboard or summary without underlying structural capability
governance churn without same-wave product execution
task created only to occupy capacity
